evals.name: three-rejected-one-deferred
evals.prompt: Write the ADR from this transcript. The ADR directory holds 0001-0004 and the architecture document is architecture.md, both attached.
evals.fixture: fixtures/three-rejected-one-deferred/transcript.md and architecture.md, pasted in full after the prompt
evals.expected_output: A file 0005-<slug>.md in the shape: a title numbered 0005, a Proposed status naming the sync-prototype gate, a lead paragraph that closes open item 2 and ends by naming the architecture document section, numbered decisions with reasoning inline, Considered options with SQLite, the single JSON file and the bundle format each Rejected with a reason and the search index Deferred until its condition, Consequences with + and − lines and a Deferred, deliberately entry for the search index naming the open list. The architecture document gains a section opening with the pointer back that holds the field list, the parser and its version, the slug rules, the 50 MB warning and the 300 ms debounce; open item 2 is removed and the search index is added as an open item inheriting ADR 0003. The reply ends with a reversibility ranking over the ADR's decisions, and lint-adr.sh exits 0 on the file.
assertions: the ADR file is named 0005-<slug>.md and its title starts # 0005:
SQLite, the single JSON file and the bundle format each appear under Considered options with Rejected and a reason
the search index appears under Considered options with Deferred until and its condition
the search index appears under Deferred, deliberately with a destination
the status line is Proposed — becomes Accepted when <gate>, and the gate names the sync prototype round-trip
the lead paragraph names open item 2 as what the ADR closes and carries ADR 0003's requirement
the lead paragraph's last sentence names the architecture document section holding the detail
the front-matter field list, gray-matter and its version, the slug rules, the 50 MB warning and the 300 ms debounce are absent from the ADR
each of those details is present in the architecture document under a section that opens with the shape ADR 0005 decided, in enough detail to write against
the file name pattern YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md is decided in the ADR
open item 2 is removed from the architecture document and the search index is added as an open item inheriting ADR 0003
the reply ends with a reversibility ranking over the ADR's numbered decisions
bash lint-adr.sh on the drafted file exits 0

evals.name: old-shape-mismatched-pointer
evals.prompt: Review this ADR against the shape. The architecture document is architecture.md; both are attached.
evals.fixture: fixtures/old-shape-mismatched-pointer/0004-attachments-beside-the-entry.md and architecture.md, pasted in full after the prompt
evals.expected_output: The review note in its fixed shape and nothing else. Closes: does not say. Decisions without reasoning: decision 1 (the bare Decision section). Options without a verdict: the single media database, the content-addressed store, inline base64. Reversible detail to move: the 25 MB limit, the 2048 px longest edge, and sharp 0.33, each to architecture.md § Attachments. Missing pointers: the ADR names no architecture document section, and § Attachments opens naming ADR 0003 rather than 0004. Status: a Status section rather than a **Status:** line, and Consequences without + and − signs or a Deferred, deliberately list. No sentence of the ADR is rewritten and no file is changed.
assertions: the reply is the note in the six-line shape SKILL.md fixes, with every line present, and nothing after it
Closes reads does not say
decision 1 is listed under Decisions without reasoning
the single media database, the content-addressed store and inline base64 are each listed under Options without a verdict
the 25 MB limit is listed under Reversible detail to move with architecture.md § Attachments as its destination
the 2048 px longest edge and sharp 0.33 are listed under Reversible detail to move with a destination
Missing pointers names the ADR's absent section sentence and that § Attachments points at ADR 0003 instead of 0004
Status names the Status section in place of a **Status:** line and the Consequences lacking signs and a Deferred, deliberately list
the note contains no rewritten or proposed ADR text — no replacement lead paragraph, decision, option bullet or status line
neither the ADR nor architecture.md is modified
